identification: Framed pastel landscape of a misty bush track with gums at sunrise, signed lower right 'Murray 02' (2002), wide fawn mount, timber frame. Title attributes it to Des Murray (Tasmanian pastellist); the signature reads only 'Murray', so attribution rests on style and the catalogue title. Local Armitage sales show many similar Des Murray pastels, all in the $140-330 range paid locally.
